type Boxes<T> = { [K in keyof T]: { value: T[K] } };
function unwrap<T>(boxes: Boxes<T>): T { return {} as T; }
const result = unwrap({ name: { value: 'text' }, size: { value: 10 } });
const wrongText: number = result.name;
const wrongSize: string = result.size;
const wrongProperty = result.missing;
const tuple: readonly [{ value: number }, { value: string }] = [{ value: 3 }, { value: 'text' }];
const reversed = unwrap(tuple);
reversed[0] = 5;
const malformed = unwrap({ name: { wrong: 'text' } });
